title: Expose supplier invoice reconciliation evidence in purchasing workflows
description: Expose ERP-065 supplier invoice allocations and ERP-066 payment-to-invoice allocations in existing Purchase Order and supplier-payment workflows. Keep ordered, received, invoiced and allocated-payment evidence separately labeled. Do not infer an accounts-payable balance, mutate source records, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: Purchase Order detail exposes active allocated supplier-invoice evidence, invoice count and unallocated or unavailable context using only persisted ERP-065 allocation rows.
Purchase Order lists expose bounded invoice-evidence summaries without issuing a database or storage query per row.
Existing supplier-payment workflows expose explicit ERP-066 invoice allocations and remaining payment evidence without replacing or duplicating the canonical payment record.

The reconciliation view displays ordered, received, supplier-invoice and explicitly allocated-payment evidence in separate labeled fields and does not net unrelated evidence into an asserted accounts-payable or settlement balance.
Amounts are grouped by currency; different currencies are never combined, converted or reassigned without an authoritative persisted conversion already belonging to the source evidence.
Draft and voided invoices and voided payment allocations are distinguished from active recorded evidence; inactive evidence is excluded from active totals but remains inspectable in history.
Supplier, currency or source-link inconsistencies in historical evidence are displayed as invalid or unavailable and are not silently repaired, reassigned or merged.
Missing invoice or payment-allocation evidence is shown as none or unknown and is never converted into uninvoiced liability, unpaid, paid, settled, outstanding, deductible or overdue status.
The UI and documentation state that this is an operational evidence view, not a general ledger, legal Supplier statement, tax filing, payment authorization or settlement confirmation.
The workflow is read-only and does not update invoices, allocations, Purchase Orders, receipts, payments, Supplier balances, inventory, finance or tax records.
Queries are bounded or paged, avoid per-row access and reuse ERP-050, ERP-065 and ERP-066 semantics rather than adding another reconciliation engine.

Unit and integration tests cover no evidence, partial and full invoice allocations, explicit payment allocations, void and invalid history, multiple Suppliers and currencies, bounded queries and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Open a Purchase Order with partial receipt, supplier-invoice allocation and explicit payment-to-invoice allocation evidence and verify all evidence classes remain separately labeled in one currency.

Inspect an order with draft, voided, mismatched or missing invoice evidence and verify it is not presented as payable, paid, settled, deductible, outstanding or overdue and that no source record changes.

human_gate.reason: Read-only presentation of repository invoice and payment-allocation evidence. No real payment, tax action, accounting posting, production mutation, deployment or release is authorized.
